# [MS-RDPBCGR] 4.3.2 Plain Notify
# Annotated example between an RDP 5.1 client and server (Standard RDP Security).
# TLS-mode rebuild of the RC4 example (the spec's decrypted dump plus new framing):
#   - removed the 12-byte non-FIPS security header (flags, flagsHi, 8-byte MAC)
#   - MCS userData length and TPKT length recomputed (TPKT 625 -> 613)
#   - every other byte is unchanged from the spec's decrypted dump
#    0  TPKT length 613; 4 X.224 DT; 7 MCS SendDataIndication (0x68): initiator 1002, channel 1003, prio high, begin|end, length 598
#   15  share control: totalLength 598, pduType 0x0017 (DATAPDU | version), pduSource 1002
#   21  share data: shareID 0x000203ea, pad1 0x00, streamId 1, uncompressedLength 598,
#       pduType2 38, compressedType 0, compressedLength 0
#   33  infoType 2 (INFOTYPE_LOGON_PLAINNOTIFY)
#   37  TS_PLAIN_NOTIFY Pad (576 zero bytes)
